content: Creation of ServiceSwComponentType s When generating the AUTOSAR Service SW-Components the actual service needs 1 expressed by the Application SW-Components are collected. For each AUTOSAR service required, a ServiceSwComponentType shall be created complete with an appropriate number of ports to enable the connection of all application component ports expressing the needs for the AUTOSAR service.
